name: Qingbao Robot
summary: Qingbao Robot is a Shanghai manufacturer of humanlike service robots. It develops robot bodies and embodied intelligence technology for visitor guidance, reception, education, live streaming and beverage-service applications. The company describes work on robot control, expressive heads, flexible joint actuators and dexterous hands, and markets both fixed and mobile service-robot configurations. Its official corporate identity is Shanghai Qingbao Engine Robot Co., Ltd.
